changes: (1) completion-check shape now validated against the producer schema, not just non-nil: a check is a vector [check-name-keyword observed-condition] (authored clauses futon2.aif.wm.authored.*, e.g. req_fbad4b8b.clj; square-derived completions cascade_enactment_compiler.clj square-derived-completion [:square-B-observed elems]). false, bare keywords, non-keyword names -> typed absent :compiled-operational-plan-step-invalid :detail :step-completion-check-malformed. Explicit note: the producer's assemble-inputs marks any clause whose :completion-check is not truthy as an owed hole, so a false check never reaches a compiled plan through the real path; the renderer now matches that contract.

(1b) digests validated as hex64 (same shape as cascade_enactment_compiler hex64?) -> typed absent :compiled-operational-plan-digests-malformed. The review's 20,000-char digest counterexample is now refused at this earlier gate, so digest bloat can no longer overflow any budget; header overflow is reachable only via huge guards/application-order.

(2) header-alone overflow handled explicitly: if the bare header plus a zero-shown counted omission marker exceeds the budget, the plan returns typed absent :compiled-operational-plan-over-budget {:header-chars :limit} -- no silent clipping of digests. Criteria has its own 12000-char guard (:compiled-completion-criteria-over-budget) and does NOT relay a plan-only over-budget (its header carries only the valid digests), so guards bloat cannot hide the checks.
